installer-gui-script.title: SpatialEQ

choice.title: SpatialEQ app
choice.description: The standalone app: EQ and spatial audio for every app on your Mac. Installs SpatialEQ.app in /Applications (macOS 14.2 or later).

choice.title: VST3 plug-in
choice.description: Installs SpatialEQ.vst3 in /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3 (Cubase, Ableton Live, REAPER, Studio One, Bitwig...).

choice.title: Audio Unit plug-in
choice.description: Installs SpatialEQ.component in /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components (Logic Pro, GarageBand, MainStage...).
